### 1. Wix AI

image alt text

image alt text

Wix AI offers AI Website Design Intelligence (ADI), which creates complete websites from conversational prompts. Users simply describe their business in natural language, and the AI generates layouts, writes content, selects images, and applies styling that matches professional standards. With built-in business solutions like appointment scheduling, online stores, event management, and payment processing automatically integrated into your site, you can start up quickly without the need for plugins or third-party tools. You can even generate custom images directly within the platform using AI, turning text descriptions into visuals that match your site’s style without needing stock photos or a graphic designer.

Key features: [...] ### 10. CodeDesign AI

image alt text

image alt text

CodeDesign AI generates complete websites from text prompts and lets you regenerate designs as many times as needed until you find the right look. The platform emphasizes flexibility in how you deploy your site—publish on their hosting, push to WordPress, or export the actual code to use anywhere. With access to over 5,000 website templates and 2,000 sales funnel templates, you can either start from scratch with AI or customize existing designs using the built-in AI tools. The service is positioned for agencies and freelancers who need to manage multiple client sites, offering bulk pricing to build and host up to 100 websites under a single subscription.

Key features: [...] ### 5. Framer

image alt text

image alt text

Framer’s AI positions itself as a professional design tool rather than a simplified website builder, giving you complete visual control over layouts, animations, and interactions without writing code. The platform includes Wireframer, an AI feature that generates complete page layouts and components to jump-start your design process, rather than starting from scratch. Built-in tools, such as a CMS for content management, analytics for tracking performance, and A/B testing for optimization, enable you to handle the entire lifecycle of a site without switching between multiple services. The platform also connects you to a marketplace of templates and a network of vetted experts, providing additional resources or professional help when needed.

### No technical skills needed

You don’t have to know how to code or design. AI builders take care of the technical side, so you can focus on your business instead of struggling with complicated tools. This makes them perfect for beginners or small business owners who just need a functional, professional-looking site.

### Affordable and accessible

Hiring a developer or designer can be expensive, but AI website builders offer a budget-friendly alternative. While they may not replace fully custom-built websites, they provide a strong starting point at a much lower cost. This makes them especially useful for startups, freelancers, and small businesses that need a website without a big investment.
